description: This file implements the 'FramePair' class for managing pairs of image frames in an object tracking system, including methods for initialization, adjusting bounding boxes, and calculating translation and scale based on feature keypoints, with associated helper functions.

classes.name: FramePair
classes.description: A class representing a pair of frames used for object tracking, providing methods to initialize, adjust bounding boxes based on keypoint data, and compute translation and scaling transformations.

methods.name: void Init(const int64_t start_time,const int64_t end_time)
methods.description: Initializes the FramePair with start and end timestamps, resetting keypoints and flags.

methods.name: void AdjustBox(const BoundingBox box,float * const translation_x,float * const translation_y,float * const scale_x,float * const scale_y) const
methods.description: Adjusts a given bounding box based on tracked keypoints to estimate translation and scale differences between frames.

methods.name: int FillWeights(const BoundingBox & box,float * const weights) const
methods.description: Computes weights for keypoints based on their proximity to a bounding box and their scores, used for median and scale calculations.

methods.name: void FillTranslations(Point2f * const translations) const
methods.description: Computes translation vectors for keypoints between the two frames.

methods.name: int FillScales(const Point2f & old_center,const Point2f & translation,float * const weights,Point2f * const scales) const
methods.description: Calculates scale factors for keypoints relative to an object center, used for determining the overall scale change.

methods.name: Point2f GetWeightedMedian(const float * const weights,const Point2f * const deltas) const
methods.description: Computes the median of keypoint translations weighted by their confidence scores.

methods.name: float GetWeightedMedianScale(const float * const weights,const Point2f * const deltas) const
methods.description: Computes the median scale factor across keypoints, combining X and Y directions.

methods.name: float GetMedian(const int num_items,const WeightedDelta * const weighted_deltas,const float sum)
int WeightedDeltaCompare(const void * const a,const void * const b)
